panel_rule: Completed cached yan-v5 historical matches, 299 transitions; exclude prior carrier-action groupings and both known fork boards; SHA256 harbor-horizon-public-v1:match/game; take first three disjoint canonical layouts per QQ seat, first develop, other two held out. Four holdouts balanced 2/2 by start and seat.
opponent: frozen v6; fixed 4x2/one modeled reply/3 tail transitions in both arms; live independent response to changed boards
experiment: Frozen Harbormaster; only root width and depth change, both use one sampled enemy response, up to 3 fixed tail steps on finalists and one rollout. Strategy timers fixed independently of process CPU measurements.
jitter: Shared per-turn, per-seat random numbers in both continuations. Costs are single thread process CPU milliseconds and explicitly counted model transitions.

calibration.rule: Among pairs within 15% median process CPU, minimize |log(cpu ratio)| + 0.3 |log(simulated-turn ratio)|. No continuation outcomes available.
